notes.title: UPDATE FROM THE NEGOTIATION TABLE!
notes.content:
[p]Thank you for your overwhelming support. The negotiations with the celebrity union (FUFFF) have been... exhausting. They've returned to us not with a simple request, but with a three-part, diamond-encrusted, legally-binding list of demands.[/p][p][/p][p]It seems they require more than money and validation; they now demand creative input from the very public they scorn. To save [b]Celebrity Kombat[/b] from being vaulted, we must meet ALL THREE of their ridiculous conditions.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Demand #1: The Financial Rider (The Appeasement Fund)[/b][/p][p]First, the obvious. Their "Artistic Endeavor" fee is non-negotiable. Virtual private jets and ego-stroking assistants don't pay for themselves.[/p][list][*][p][b]THE MISSION:[/b] We need to sell [b]1000[/b] new copies of the game to fill their "Appeasement Fund." Every purchase helps meet their financial demands.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Demand #2: The "Public Adoration Clause"[/b][/p][p]Their egos require constant praise. They refuse to be associated with a title rated as merely "Mixed," calling it "a statistical insult."[/p][list][*][p][b]THE MISSION:[/b] We must raise the game's official Steam rating to [b]"Mostly Positive."[/b] They demand proof of public adoration.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]Demand #3: The "Choreography Mandate"[/b][/p][p]And here's the latest absurdity. They claim their "flawless" combat techniques are being "poorly executed and misunderstood" by the player base. Therefore, they are mandating a public consultation to design new moves "worthy of their star power."[/p][list][*][p][b]THE MISSION:[/b] The community must actively contribute to improving their move sets. We will create a dedicated thread on our Steam forums titled [b]"The Official FUFFF Choreography Mandate."[/b] We need our best and brightest players to suggest new moves, combos, and finishers for our celebrity cast.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]This Is Our Three-Front War! Here's the Battle Plan:[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Every single one of you is now a key part of this rescue operation.[/p][list][*][p][b]For New Fighters & Wishlist Warriors:[/b] You lead the charge on Demand #1. [b]Purchase Celebrity Kombat[/b] to fund the war chest. Every copy sold is a direct blow to their financial tyranny.[/p][/*][*][p][b]For Our Veteran Champions (Existing Owners):[/b]
You are the heart of our PR campaign for Demand #2. It costs nothing but a moment of your time. If you enjoy the game, [b]please leave an honest review on our Steam page[/b] to help us reach "Mostly Positive."[/p][/*][*][p][b]For ALL Players, New and Old (The Creative Division):[/b]
Unleash your genius for Demand #3. Head to the [b]"Choreography Mandate"[/b] thread in our Steam forums and give us your best ideas. Your suggestions will directly influence the future of combat in the game (if we save it!).[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The objective is absolute. We must fill the fund, raise the rating, AND gather brilliant new ideas before the deadline on [b]October 15th, 2025[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]If we fail on even ONE of these fronts, the game is gone.[/p][p]Let's show these divas the true power of a united community![/p][p][/p][p]For the Future of the Fight,[/p][p]The Team at [b]Celebrity Kombat Corp.[/b][/p]

notes.title: Big Upgrade, CR7 & Messi, New engine...
notes.content:
Hi Folks!

Today is a big day: new menus, upgraded fighting engine, upgraded 3D engine, new characters, new maps, more optimized...

Say hello to 2 soccer monsters: CR7 and Messi!

The game is still in beta, and we are still improving a lot of things, but we are very proud of this new step.

In order to balance each character and create a fun game, we are also looking for people to help us  testing and balancing.

Keep an eye out, people, more is on the way.

SIUUUUUUUUUUU!


(The list of updated items, for those who are interested:)

- New Character: Cristiano "CR7" Ronaldo
- New Character: Lionel "El Maestro" Messi
- Enhanced 3D engine
- Enhanced fighting engine
	- No more network desync
	- Animations improved
- Full controller compatible 
- New 3D main menu
- New 3D options menu
- New 3D character selection screen menu 
- New 3D Loading menu
- Reworking of all the characters (WIP)
- Heavy optimization (up to 4x less RAM used)
- Some hit boxes corrected
- Some intro corrected
- Some clipping problems corrected

notes.title: All characters finally available and unlockable in King Fight mode!
notes.content:
[h2]Today is a big day, we are delighted to announce that the main character roster is now complete![/h2]

[h3]Which means a new game mode is now available [b]"King Fight"[/b]!
Face your opponents to become the King and unlock the 10 other characters available!

However, the game remains in Beta while we correct the bugs and we are counting on your feedback to help us balance the characters and test the network.
Give us feedback on [url=https://discord.com/invite/z6ng3SQgck]Discord[/url]!

The best is yet to come my friends.
We anticipate lots of improvements, this is only the beginning of the Celebrity Kombat adventure![/h3]

[u]Here is a list of features we would like to add in the future if the community is supporting us:[/u]
[list]
[*] Multiplayer Ranking System.
[*] A spectacular story mode with cinematic.
[*] Improve character presentation
[*] Improve 3D character models.
[*] Improve movesets and Animations.
[*] Improve combo potential, whether for novices or complex combos for experienced players.
[*] Fatalities at the end of fights.
[*] Improve user interface, as well as options with the possibility of changing keys mapping.
[*] Compatibility for controllers, arcade sticks and all kinds of controls.
[*] Compatibility on SteamDeck and Playstation 5.
[*] Cosmetic for character and custom animations for mock.
[/list]

[h3]We are very excited for the future, we want to provide you with the best experience with these personalities, to make it the best fighting game of the kind!

Thank you to the community for the supports and a special thanks to Elliot!
See you on discord and on the ring!
[/h3]
[u]Patch Note v1.4.0:[/u]
[list]
[*] New Characters added:
 Taylor "Blondie" Swift
 Amber "Slim" Heard
[*] Added King Fight Mode
[*] Added Jump Sound effect
[*] Elon Musk's cape physics updated
[*] Music volume during character introduction decreased
[*] Stamp audio for warning screen removed
[/list]

Hi everyone!

It's a big day! Celebrity Kombat, a game where you can pick a celebrity and battle others, is being released today.
[url=https://www.patreon.com/CelebrityKombat]Patreon[/url]

We have a detailed roadmap, so please check out our website, social media accounts, and patreon page to support us. Several aspects of the next steps:

[list]
[*] New characters
[*] Characters introduction
[*] Fatalities
[*] Assist moves (Mini Me for trump,  etc)
[*] Better textures quality
[*] New maps
[*] New stories
[*] Damage and bruise effects 
[/list]

Stay tuned, a lot of heavy stuff is coming
